name: 11-budget-and-prefill
about: A preset with three relative prompts, a persona, and system_prompts.assistant_prefill carrying raw macro syntax ('{{char}} looks at {{user}}:') to prove assemblePrompt passes assistantPrefill through UNEXPANDED: preset-loader.ts reads presetAssistantPrefill straight off the system_prompts blob (readSystemPrompt) and assemblePrompt's final return statement assigns it to result.assistantPrefill verbatim -- there is no macro-processing call on that variable anywhere in between, so the recorded field still contains the literal '{{char}}'/'{{user}}' macro syntax. input.contextLimit (1100) and maxResponseTokens (300) are small next to 13 history messages of ~300 chars each (12 numbered turns plus the character's greeting), so history gets trimmed and it is visibly partial, not 0 and not the whole history like 05-no-preset-overfull: the recorded conversationHistory keeps the greeting and turns 5-12, drops turns 1-4, and keeps the current-turn message. Recording-verified quirk worth a note for the port: messagesTrimmed reports 1, not the 4 history entries actually missing. prompt-assembly.ts touches history in at least three places before returning -- a loose pre-trim ahead of chatMessages construction (~line 3273, PRE_TRIM_RESERVE=2048, historyBudget = max(floor(contextLimit*0.6), contextLimit-2048)) that is invisible to messagesTrimmed entirely, then the mid-assembly budgetManager pass ('messagesTrimmed = originalMessageCount - trimmedChatMessages.length'), then a final hard-cap re-measure (finalPassBudgetTrim) that adds its own dropped count. Only the latter two are counted, so the uncounted first pass is the most likely reason the counter undercounts here. This fixture records the undercount as ground truth; a faithful port must reproduce messagesTrimmed = 1 for this input, not a value corrected to match the visible history delta.

characters.name: Vera
characters.description: Vera keeps the lighthouse at Gull Point. {{char}} is wary of {{user}}.
characters.scenario: A storm has stranded {{user}} at the lighthouse.
characters.first_mes: *Vera opens the door a crack.* You picked a bad night, {{user}}.

details.appearance: Soaked oilskin coat, a satchel of charts.
